# NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This non-disclosure agreement (“Agreement”) is dated [__] (“Effective Date”) and is entered into by and between:

[__] (“Party 1”)

AND

[__] (“Party 2”)

Party 1 and Party 2 are hereinafter referred to individually as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties". Wherever the context requires, the Party disclosing the confidential information shall be referred to as the “Disclosing Party” and the Party receiving the confidential information shall be referred to as the “Receiving Party”.

Whereas:

1. Party 1 engages in [__] and Party 2 engages in [__].
2. The Parties wish to collaborate and enter into discussions for the purpose of [__] (“Purpose”) and wish to keep such discussions confidential.

Now therefore, in consideration for the mutual promises and covenants set forth herein, the Parties agree as follows:

1. “Confidential Information” shall mean and include all non-public information, written or oral, disclosed, directly or indirectly, through any means of communication or observation (including oral, graphic, written or electronic form) by the Disclosing Party or any of its affiliates or representatives to or for the benefit of the Receiving Party from the Effective Date, irrespective of whether such information:
1. has been specifically marked as “confidential” at the time of disclosure;
2. is treated as proprietary information by the Disclosing Party; or
3. is owned or developed by the Disclosing Party.
2. Confidential Information shall include any financial, business, proprietary or technical information of the Disclosing Party.
3. All such Confidential Information shared under this Agreement shall be used by the Parties exclusively for the Purpose and neither Party shall disclose or otherwise use the Confidential Information for any other purpose or in any other manner without the prior written approval of the Disclosing Party.
4. The Confidential Information shared under this Agreement may be disclosed by the Receiving Party to other employees on a need to know basis, with written consent from the Disclosing Party, in connection with the Purpose, and who shall protect the Confidential Information in accordance with the terms of this Agreement.
5. The Receiving Party shall protect the Confidential Information in the same manner as it would protect its own confidential information.
6. The confidentiality obligations under this Agreement shall not apply to Confidential Information which:
1. was in the public domain or generally available to the public prior to receipt thereof by Receiving Party from the Disclosing Party, or which subsequently becomes part of the public domain or generally available to the public other than as a result of a breach of this Agreement by Receiving Party;
2. was in the possession of Receiving Party prior to receipt from the Disclosing Party;
3. is later lawfully received by Receiving Party from a third party without any confidentiality restrictions applicable;
4. is independently created or developed by the Receiving Party without use or reference of the Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party; or,
5. is required to be disclosed by operation of applicable law.
7. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, Confidential Information may be disclosed as required by applicable law, regulations or governmental procedure, provided the Receiving Party notifies the Disclosing Party prior to such disclosure, unless prohibited by law, so as to afford the Disclosing Party the opportunity to seek a protective order or other appropriate remedy.

ground_truth: Either party may terminate this agreement with written notice upon material breach.
The party agrees not to engage in competitive activities for a defined period after termination.
Aggregate liability shall not exceed the total fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.
Invoices are due within thirty days of receipt and late payments accrue interest.
All work product created by the contractor is assigned to the client upon full payment.
This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other party.
Neither party may assign this agreement without prior written consent of the other party.
The agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless notice is given 30 days prior.
Each party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims arising from its own negligence.
Failure to pay, breach of confidentiality, or violation of IP terms constitutes a material breach.
A party must provide thirty days written notice to terminate this agreement without cause.
The client has the right to audit the contractor's records upon reasonable written notice.
Disputes shall first be subject to mediation before proceeding to binding arbitration.
The service provider warrants that services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
Each party shall comply with applicable data protection laws and implement reasonable security measures.
Neither party is liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond their reasonable control.
Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages under any circumstances.
The buyer commits to a minimum annual purchase volume as specified in the attached schedule.
Prices may be adjusted annually with sixty days written notice to the other party.
